items.title: Hindustan Copper Q1 Results: PAT zooms 163% YoY to Rs 353 crore; revenue rises to Rs 937 crore
items.description: Hindustan Copper reported a 163% year-on-year jump in Q1FY27 net profit to Rs 353 crore, while revenue from operations rose 81.4% to Rs 936.5 crore. EBITDA more than doubled to Rs 507.5 crore from Rs 212.3 crore, with EBITDA margin expanding to 54% from 41% a year earlier, the state-owned miner said in a regulatory filing.

items.title: Info Edge Q1 Results: Standalone Profit falls 6% YoY to Rs 245 crore
items.description: Info Edge reported a 6% YoY decline in Q1 standalone net profit to Rs 245 crore, impacted by a Rs 72.1 crore exceptional loss. However, revenue rose 12% to Rs 824 crore, while profit before tax before exceptional items jumped 23% to Rs 427 crore, driven by strong recruitment and real estate growth.

items.title: Zee Entertainment Q1 Results: PAT falls 48% YoY to Rs 74 crore; ad revenue hit by Middle East crisis
items.description: Zee Entertainment’s Q1 FY27 profit fell 48% to Rs 74.3 crore, while EBITDA plunged 65% despite 5% revenue growth. Advertising faced pressure from Middle East tensions and cricket, partly offset by FIFA rights, subscription growth and higher digital ARPU.

items.title: Vodafone Idea Q1 Results: Loss narrows to Rs 3,754 crore; revenue rises 6% YoY
items.description: Vodafone Idea Q1 Results: Debt-ridden telco Vodafone Idea on Monday narrowed its consolidated losses in the first quarter to Rs 3,754 crore. The loss stood at Rs 6,608 crore in the last year quarter. Revenue from operations increased 6% YoY to Rs 11,689 crore.

items.title: Fusion Finance turns profitable as asset quality improves sharply
items.description: Fusion Finance reported a Rs 62.4 crore Q1 profit, reversing a year-ago loss, as improving asset quality lifted performance. Gross NPA declined to 2.5%, while net interest margin improved. A strong capital adequacy ratio and higher AUM further strengthened the lender’s balance sheet.
